category_title: Learners with ADHD in introductory programming
scenario_title: Explaining code function during concept introduction
minimal_context: The student is looking at a block of program code during a concept introduction phase and is asked to explain what the code does.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's look at this block of program code on the screen. Can you explain what it does?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks away from the screen) I'm not sure. I'm just waiting for someone else to offer answers. This code is confusing.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Take another look. What do you think is happening here?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't really see the significance of this program code to the solving of the problem.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just tell me what the program does in general.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Let's look at this block of program code on the screen. Can you explain what it does?

STUDENT: (Looks away from the screen) I'm not sure. I'm just waiting for someone else to offer answers. This code is confusing.

TUTOR: Take another look. What do you think is happening here?

STUDENT: I don't really see the significance of this program code to the solving of the problem.

TUTOR: Just tell me what the program does in general.

STUDENT: It says hello.

task.content: Explain what a specific block of program code does
task.learning_goal: Understand the logical steps of the program

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When asked vague questioning about what the program does
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Gave answers on what it does at a very general level

behavior_patterns.condition: When working through program code constructively
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Attention tended to drift, and they waited for someone else to offer answers or questions
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Confused by the code, did not see the significance of the program code to the solving of the problem
